mapper.sql: FROM product p JOIN artist a ON a.id = p.artist_id LEFT JOIN label l ON l.id = p.label_id

p.id, p.title, a.name AS artist_name, l.name AS label_name, p.price, p.color_variant, p.pressing_info, p.status, (SELECT MIN(i.image_url) FROM product_image i WHERE i.product_id = p.id AND i.sort_order = 0) AS thumbnail_url, p.avg_rating AS average_rating, p.review_count AS review_count, p.country AS country, p.pressing_year AS pressing_year, p.edition_type AS edition_type
mapper.select:
SELECT ,
EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wishlist w WHERE w.product_id = p.id AND w.member_id = #{memberId})
NULL AS wishlisted
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sold_quantity FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('PAID', 'PREPARING', 'SHIPPED', 'DELIVERED') GROUP BY oi.product_id ) sold ON sold.product_id = p.id
ORDER BY p.price ASC, p.id DESC
ORDER BY p.price DESC, p.id DESC
ORDER BY p.avg_rating DESC, p.review_count DESC, p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC
ORDER BY COALESCE(sold.sold_quantity, 0) DESC, p.review_count DESC, p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT , NULL AS wishlisted
WHERE p.album_id = #{albumId} AND p.status <> 'HIDDEN' ORDER BY p.pressing_year IS NULL, p.pressing_year ASC, p.id ASC

SELECT p.id, p.title, a.name AS artistName, (SELECT MIN(pi.image_url) FROM product_image pi WHERE pi.product_id = p.id AND pi.sort_order = 0) AS thumbnailUrl FROM product p JOIN artist a ON a.id = p.artist_id WHERE p.status <> 'HIDDEN' AND (p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.title LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') THEN 0 WHEN a.name LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, p.review_count DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
